aiSystems.name: Production RAG
aiSystems.summary: A production-shaped retrieval system that combines dense and sparse search, reranks candidates, and returns grounded answers with resolvable citations—or refuses.
evidence: Hybrid dense + sparse retrieval with RRF
Two-tier offline evaluation and generated scorecards

aiSystems.name: Agentic Research
aiSystems.summary: A bounded plan → retrieve → critique research loop with explicit budgets, terminal states, cited synthesis, and deterministic execution traces.
evidence: Fake and HTTP retrieval behind one port
Explicit stop reasons and evidence gaps
Byte-stable traces on the free path

aiSystems.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
aiSystems.summary: An orchestrator and specialist agents with explicit handoffs, global budgets, failure isolation, and auditable multi-agent timelines.

aiSystems.name: RepoMind
aiSystems.summary: Repository intelligence built around AST-aware chunks, symbol retrieval, fixture-backed evaluation, and precise path:line citations.

aiSystems.name: AI Platform
aiSystems.summary: A service gateway for the portfolio with authentication, rate limits, request propagation, aggregate health, and compose-based operations.

selectedWork.name: RutBusiness
selectedWork.summary: An on-premise ERP/POS for Chilean small businesses: a Rust/Axum server, embedded SurrealKV, native Android client, Tauri desktop, and web operator.

selectedWork.name: FarmaciaCompare
selectedWork.summary: A Chilean pharmacy price-comparison platform spanning a TypeScript web experience and Python-backed data and service workflows.

selectedWork.name: Prescribo
selectedWork.summary: A Next.js prototype for signed prescriptions, orders, certificates, QR verification, short links, and pharmacy-side validation.
selectedWork.note: Prototype only; not for real PHI or legally valid FEA documents.

selectedWork.name: GeoAgent
selectedWork.summary: A cross-platform geo-intelligence codebase spanning TypeScript web, Kotlin Android, Rust desktop components, maps, and analytical surfaces.

capabilities.title: AI systems
capabilities.description: Retrieval and agent behavior designed as inspectable systems, not prompt demos.

capabilities.title: Backend & platform
capabilities.description: Typed APIs and operational seams across Python and Rust services.

capabilities.title: Product surfaces
capabilities.description: One engineering language per surface when that is the honest product trade-off.

capabilities.title: Delivery & trust
capabilities.description: Quality gates, explicit failure modes, and evidence that survives outside the author's laptop.

principles.title: Evidence over adjectives
principles.copy: A capability is linked to code, a test, a release, or a runnable path. Planned work stays visibly planned.

principles.title: Failure is a product state
principles.copy: Refusal, degradation, budget exhaustion, and dependency failure are modeled explicitly instead of hidden behind a successful response.

principles.title: Free path first
principles.copy: Core demos run without credentials or billed calls, so reviewers can inspect the whole system rather than trust screenshots.
